overview.en: Bocourt’s terrific skink is a large New Caledonian skink, known today only from small islets near Île des Pins.
overview.fr: Le scinque géant de Bocourt est un grand scinque néo-calédonien, aujourd’hui connu seulement de petits îlots près de l’île des Pins.

identification.en: It has an elongated body, short limbs, a robust tail and large, curved front teeth; it is the largest skink in New Caledonia.
identification.fr: Il a un corps allongé, des membres courts, une queue robuste et de grandes dents recourbées à l’avant ; c’est le plus grand scinque de Nouvelle-Calédonie.

habitat.en: It is associated with low coastal forest on offshore islets.
habitat.fr: Il est associé à la forêt littorale basse des îlots côtiers.

diet.en: A 2022 study identified a land crab in its diet and found its bite force sufficient to crack hard crab shells.
diet.fr: Une étude de 2022 a identifié un crabe terrestre dans son régime et estimé que sa morsure peut briser des carapaces dures.

behavior.en: Field observations are scarce; the species is thought to be mainly terrestrial, although individuals have also been seen climbing trunks.
behavior.fr: Les observations de terrain sont rares ; l’espèce serait surtout terrestre, mais des individus ont aussi été vus en train de grimper aux troncs.

reproduction.en: Its breeding biology and clutch size remain unknown.
reproduction.fr: Sa biologie de reproduction et la taille de ses pontes restent inconnues.

ecology.en: It is one of two New Caledonian species in Phoboscincus; the other, P. garnieri, is much more widespread and has smoother scales.
ecology.fr: C’est l’une des deux espèces néo-calédoniennes du genre Phoboscincus ; l’autre, P. garnieri, est bien plus répandue et possède des écailles plus lisses.

conservation.en: A 2017 New Caledonian Red List assessment classed it as Critically Endangered, citing its tiny known range and threats such as habitat damage and introduced predators.
conservation.fr: Une évaluation de la Liste rouge néo-calédonienne de 2017 l’a classée « en danger critique », en raison de son aire connue minuscule et de menaces comme la dégradation de l’habitat et les prédateurs introduits.

title.en: The Terrific Skink bite force suggests insularity as a likely driver to exceptional resource use — peer-reviewed study
title.fr: La force de morsure du scinque terrifiant suggère le rôle de l’insularité — étude évaluée par les pairs

facts: The 2022 study describes the skink as known from tiny New Caledonian islets and identifies land-crab prey; biomechanical estimates suggest a strong bite capable of cracking hard crab shells.

title.fr: Phoboscincus bocourti — Endemia, Liste rouge néo-calédonienne

facts: Endemia describes morphology, coastal forest, scarce terrestrial and climbing observations, unknown reproduction, and the 2017 CR assessment with threats.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Phoboscincus — Endemia, New Caledonian genus account
title.fr: Phoboscincus — Endemia, fiche du genre néo-calédonien

facts: The genus contains two New Caledonian species; P. garnieri is widespread while P. bocourti is restricted, and their scale textures differ.
The genus account says reproductive mode and clutch size are unknown.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: The exact occupied range and population trend remain poorly known; Endemia’s cited assessment dates from 2017.
The 2022 study combines limited natural-history observations with biomechanical modelling, not a full dietary survey.
review_note: Compared the 2022 peer-reviewed bite-force study with Endemia’s French species and genus accounts. P. garnieri is a close relative, but no reciprocal profile currently exists.
